title: ‘Right to Breathe’: Delhi Protesters Take Clean-Air Demand to Environment Ministry

ai.summary: Delhi residents protested at India Gate demanding lasting action on toxic air, after police stated the site was not a permitted venue for such gatherings.

facts.claim: Delhi residents protested at India Gate
facts.quote: ‘Right to Breathe’: Delhi Protesters Take Clean-Air Demand to Environment Ministry

facts.quote: police said the site was not a permitted venue

ai.background_note: Residents went to India Gate in November 2025 to demand lasting action on Delhi's toxic air, but police denied the site as a permitted venue, leading to over 20 arrests and serious charges during a second protest.
